entry_state: Chapter12 closes with group-specific transition measurement,opening-equity effects and separate reinsurance recovery. The actual Munich Re disclosures retain rounded figures,populations and entity-specific risk choices without reconstructing missing group inputs. Insurance event interfaces require exact group evidence and independent component/journal reconciliation;runtime,domain and actuarial acceptance remain open. The next chapter develops implementation contracts.
exit_state: The implementation proposal assigns committed records to one transactional owner and treats exports as derived. Versioned requests preserve exact inputs and distinguish operation disposition from financial and mathematical status. Corrections create new views with transitive candidate-set invalidation; durable publication, migration and replay have observable obligations. Plugins must disclose material state and return unresolved coverage when solvers cannot decide. Human review and adapter details remain to be read.
findings: Pages337-339 were actually read in the preceding context; their retained observations are incorporated here without claiming a second image read.
The module and persistent-relation tables are legible. Python, SQLite and columnar exports are explicitly inspectability and scale choices, without production performance evidence.
The missing-cash example correctly retains mass2/5 and derives [104,116] only from the supplied bounds. Reporting120 alone would condition on computation success.

The correction section explains candidate-set dependencies, delayed descendants and separate correction/invalidation records; the storage section makes durability and migration experimentally testable rather than inferred from a library choice.
